headline: Anitta Receives Nomination For The 68th Annual Grammy Awards 2027
metaDescription: Brazilian artist Anitta has been nominated for a Grammy Award for Best Global Music Album for her work on the record titled Equilibrium.
aiSummaryBullets: Anitta earned a nomination for Best Global Music Album at the 68th Grammy Awards.
The nomination recognizes her album Equilibrium, which was released in two parts throughout 2026.
The official Grammy ceremony is scheduled to take place on February 7, 2027.
aiContextParagraph: The Recording Academy has announced the preliminary nominations for the 68th annual Grammy Awards, scheduled for February 7, 2027. Among the initial list of nominees is the Brazilian artist Anitta, who received recognition in the category of Best Global Music Album for her project Equilibrium. The album was released in two separate installments during 2026. The announcement, which was broadcast live via YouTube on November 16, 2026, also included other international artists such as Olivia Rodrigo. Organizers indicated that the complete list of nominees for the upcoming awards season is expected to be finalized in the near future. The event represents one of the major annual music industry recognitions, with this cycle highlighting various works published throughout the preceding calendar year. The academy continues its selection process leading up to the live broadcast event in early 2027.
whyItIsViral: 1 independent outlet is covering this story.
